svg.title: Lunar datum precision with and without orbiter links
svg.desc: Precision of the seven-parameter lunar datum (three translations, a scale and three rotations) from Earth-station ranging, with and without orbiter-to-surface-station ranges, from a real run of engine v0.38.0 on scenarios/lunar-infrastructure-frame-coestimation.toml. The Cramer-Rao sigma of the translations and rotations falls with the orbiter links (for example t_z from 0.98 m to 0.046 m); the smallest information eigenvalue rises 111-fold and the CRLB trace falls to 1.0 % (bar F3 MET). This assumes the orbit is known in the lunar axes, with its error carried by the orbiter range sigma of 1 m. MODELLED: a restricted three-body model with stated simplifications and illustrative inputs, not a measurement of any lunar quantity. Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service.
